definition: General Language Understanding Evaluation, a collection of diverse natural language understanding tasks used to benchmark NLP models.
details: GLUE was influential in driving progress on pretrained language models in the years before large generative LLMs became dominant, and was later followed by the harder SuperGLUE benchmark as models began to saturate it.
story: Imagine a driving test that every new model has to pass before it is allowed on the road. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. It is the exam that keeps everyone honest. That shared ruler is GLUE Benchmark.

citation.title: GLUE: A Multi-Task Benchmark and Analysis Platform for Natural Language Understanding
